objective: Ship This as a Finished Product.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Electrical dependency and energy safety in retained physical lanes
source_inspections.decision_reason: Actual host power/resource assumptions and physical-actuator lanes can affect electrical function and safety. Desktop code does not establish an installed electrical design.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Sources, loads, operating modes, units and interfaces
Protection, qualified authority, isolation, emergency stop and field recovery

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Record actual selected sources, loads, protection, isolation, grounding, thermal/environment and stored-energy constraints with exact versions, instruments and qualified review before energization or operation. Keep simulation, ratings, inspection and installed measurements distinct. Custom electrical design/installation is not implied by this software build; desktop-only construction exemptions require a bounded impact/reopening record.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Electronic device interfaces, tolerances and actual assembly evidence
source_inspections.decision_reason: Retained sensor/actuator and hardware-custody dependencies require actual electronic interface and failure assumptions, even when CETA does not design a circuit.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Circuit/component/firmware identity, constraints and device interfaces
Safe power/fault behavior, substitutions, calibrated qualification and lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Resolve exact selected assembly/firmware revisions, signals, clocks, rails, tolerances, power-up/brownout/fault behavior, calibration, thermal/EMC, substitutes and test access. Supplier statements and nominal simulation are bounded inputs. No schematic, part pinout, production assembly, certification or hardware operating result was invented.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Host hardware/software contracts and bounded resources
source_inspections.decision_reason: The Windows product materially depends on compute, memory, storage, drivers, model accelerators, power, reset, boot, update and resource-failure behavior.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Compute allocation, memory/storage/I/O contracts, timing and placement
Trust, failure containment, controlled update, installed evidence and recovery

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Bind actual workload, host/unit, hardware/firmware/driver revisions, configuration and budgets. Verify storage integrity, exhaustion, concurrency, reset/update interruption, rollback, diagnostics and recovery on the actual supported host. A boot or benchmark does not prove readiness. CETA performs no boot reconfiguration or firmware operation here.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Mechanical consequence limits of retained device/actuator lanes
source_inspections.decision_reason: Explicit physical lanes can involve motion, loads, enclosures, access, temperature and service hazards. Their qualification cannot be inferred from desktop contract tests.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Loads, motion, physical environment, interfaces and human access
Guards, exact action authority, independent qualification and lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: For each selected physical system resolve loads/motion, material/geometry/tolerance interfaces, guards, human access, environmental/thermal constraints and qualified evidence. No CAD, material property, safety factor, lifting/pressure approval or manufacturing change was fabricated. Desktop-only mechanical construction clauses require impact justification; manual protected stop and safe physical recovery remain open.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Human use and serviceability of selected physical products
source_inspections.decision_reason: The retained device lane has physical human-use, accessibility, safety and service implications; aesthetic or digital renderings cannot validate them.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Users, form/function, ergonomic controls and interface constraints
Access, hazards, production/service limits, evidence and acceptance

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Retain actual audience/use context, ergonomics, controls, material/finish/production constraints, access, service, repair and disposal where a device is selected. Do not invent anthropometry, representative users, cultural preference, new industrial hardware or manufacturing requirements unrelated to the actual adapter. Preserve accessibility and real user/domain review before a physical product claim.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Upstream semiconductor dependency identity and supplier limits
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA relies on supplied processors, memory, accelerators and possible hardware anchors. It does not currently own silicon/process/mask/foundry engineering.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Supplied device/package provenance and hardware trust assumptions
Population/environment-qualified supplier evidence and controlled change

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep actual device/process/package/supplier identity and affected timing, aging, security, resource and qualification assumptions attributable when selecting hardware. Vendor or small-sample data does not qualify a field population. No tape-out, mask, yield, fab, export regime or custom chip program is required by the current scope. Reopen direct design clauses if CETA actually designs/substitutes a device/process or depends on such claims.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Upstream board revision and device-interface qualification
source_inspections.decision_reason: Selected devices may rely on board revision, electrical/firmware interfaces and as-built behavior. The current CETA scope creates no PCB geometry, stackup or fabrication output.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Board/library/as-built revision and dependent interfaces
Actual test access, supplier variation, substitution and lifecycle evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: For an actual selected board retain revision/lot/library/component/firmware identity, critical interface and test/field assumptions, substitutions and recovery evidence. Board review or simulation is not as-built proof. Do not invent a CETA PCB or respin program. Reopen direct design/manufacturing clauses on any real board/layout/assembly change or claim whose correctness relies on these properties.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Firmware and privileged device dependency boundaries
source_inspections.decision_reason: Physical adapters and hardware custody can depend on boot, firmware, drivers, image and update semantics. Compilation alone cannot establish those semantics.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Hardware/firmware/image/interface and deterministic resource contracts
Privilege, update/signing authority, failure/recovery and target evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Bind actual target/register/interface, firmware image/source/build/toolchain, interrupts, memory/timing, reset/brownout/watchdog and diagnostics. Keep signed release/update authority, anti-rollback and recoverability explicit. No firmware was created, signed, flashed or approved for field use. Real representative hardware, update interruption and rollback evidence remain required for any enabled dependent claim.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Embedded timing, images and physical control in selected adapters
source_inspections.decision_reason: An actual device/controller variant of the retained physical lane must respect target timing, power, interrupts, resource, update and safety boundaries.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Target/source/image lineage, timing, scheduling and hardware interfaces
Authority, faults/power loss, secure updates and representative target evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep designed code, host-tested build, flashed image and observed target behavior separate. Resolve actual target/BSP/compiler/flags/interfaces, scheduling, watchdogs, diagnostics, faults, secure update and recovery. No target/field population, timing class, regulated safety regime, signing permission or embedded implementation is invented. Host fixtures prove bounded contracts; representative target and independent evidence remain open.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Networked-device variant of the retained device lane
source_inspections.decision_reason: The manifested device/physical adapter contract can cover connected devices, but no fleet, device class, enrollment service, cloud provider or collection scope is selected.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Device identity, enrollment, telemetry purpose and versioned protocol
Scoped command authority, replay/partition/update and physical outcomes

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Before a networked variant, bind exact device/owner/firmware/protocol, provisioning and revocation, telemetry purpose, command freshness/ordering/replay/idempotency and safe partition/offline/update behavior. A digital twin is bounded data, not current physical truth or command authority. Keep actual fleet/locations/scale and field recovery open without inventing fleet operations or activating collection.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Underlying communications service and physical adapter assumptions
source_inspections.decision_reason: The local product has communications dependencies and retained network/device adapters. It does not become a carrier, radio service or telephony product by applying this source.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Endpoint/service/medium identity, quality and bounded traffic assumptions
Security/privacy, congestion/partition/failover and actual service evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Resolve actual endpoint/path/medium/protocol and measured loss, delay, jitter, ordering, capacity, admission, priority, privacy and recovery where material. Carrier claims and average bandwidth do not prove end-to-end outcome. Spectrum, geography, emergency telephony and service commitments are not selected; revisit their actual authority and evidence before any such operational path.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Signal acquisition and interpretation in voice/screen/device lanes
source_inspections.decision_reason: Explicit voice, selected-screen and device observations transform signals into uncertain information. Processing outputs and model confidence are not ground truth.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Acquisition-to-output lineage, calibration, time, units and purpose
Uncertain interpretation, authority, hostile signals and outcome evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Bind actual source/sensor, capture authority, time/sample/units, calibration, preprocessing/algorithm/model/threshold, quality and uncertainty. Test aliasing, missing/saturated/noisy/shifted/replayed inputs, drift, numerical/resource limits and safe downstream use. No calibration regime, dataset, ground truth, acceptable error or detection claim is fabricated. Preserve the original heading/body defect described below; map actual body roles explicitly.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Computational supervision and retained physical feedback-control limits
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA supervises an operating cycle and retains physical actuation. Feedback capability does not supply authority or prove robustness on an actual plant.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Loop/mode/state identity, feedback timing, limits and control boundaries
Exact authority, independent stop, faults and plant-specific evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep plant/controller/estimator/supervisor/safety-monitor/operator roles and current mode/limits explicit. Actual physical control requires identified sampling/delay/noise/saturation, bounded adaptive changes, manual override, independent stop, calibration, faults and verified recovery. Do not invent a plant, tuning approval, stability margin or live test.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Robot/control variant of retained physical capability lanes
source_inspections.decision_reason: REQ-33-03 retains physical devices and interlocks; any selected robot variant needs mission, environment, autonomy, human-proximity and physical-outcome qualification.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Mission/environment, embodiment, maps, sensors and bounded autonomy
Exact targets/authority, interlocks/manual stop and field qualification

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep actual mission/robot/workspace/map/sensor/actuator/controller/operator identity and authority bounded. Separate perception, planning, control and independent safety monitor; test stale maps, collisions, link/power/sensor loss, geofence, manual stop, update and recovery on actual targets. No robot/mission/autonomy class, domain specialist or field success is invented, and no physical lane was operated.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Native human control, comprehension and usable recovery
source_inspections.decision_reason: Users/operators must understand and control the requested native system across ordinary, ambiguous, denied, interrupted and assistive paths.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Population/task/context and perceivable state/action/feedback
Consent, access, denial/correction/recovery and representative evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Declare actual tasks/populations/devices/access modes without invented personas or inferred disability, consent or comprehension. Test real state/action feedback, task outcomes, correction/stop/appeal, latency and recovery including AI failure. Keep observation, researcher interpretation and acceptance separate; clicks and silence do not prove benefit.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Stateful actions, feedback and reversible native interaction
source_inspections.decision_reason: The native experience needs explicit understandable states, pending authority, errors and accessible cancellation/correction rather than a polished nominal flow.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Goals/states/actions, focus, feedback, content and permissions
Cancellation, error/undo/correction, access and implementation fidelity

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Bind actions to actual use cases and state machines, focus/input/feedback, exact permissions, timing, undo where real, and truthful uncertain/terminal states. Test stale approvals, late callbacks, interruption, keyboard/assistive alternatives and recovery. A confirmation dialogue is not enforcement and disabling a control without explanation is not usable denial.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Continuity across setup, work, failures and next-session experience
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA's user outcome spans setup, conversation, actions, memory, models, restart, support and recovery; one attractive screen cannot qualify that journey.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Population/journey, expectations and frontstage/backstage continuity
Privacy/access, support/dependency failure and real recovered outcome

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Map frontstage/backstage dependencies and real multi-step outcomes. Preserve intent, scope, evidence and accessible help across errors/channel transitions/AI loss. Do not infer emotion, satisfaction, consent or universal preference from the user's messages or proxy analytics. Actual end-to-end and affected-user evidence remain required.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Whole local service outcome and accountable support handoffs
source_inspections.decision_reason: The local product coordinates people, processes, policy, model/tool suppliers and support/recovery. Outsourcing a dependency does not outsource outcome accountability.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Outcome/actors, service definition, handoffs and dependency ownership
Actual delivery, capacity, supplier failure, redress and recovery evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Link actual service state and wait/denial explanation to use cases, dependency ownership, queues/capacity and accessible non-AI/manual alternatives. Keep eligibility, commitments, staffing, supplier and compensation choices explicit when actually selected; do not invent a subscription service, SLA, support team or compensation authority.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Product experience priorities tied to the full authorized mission
source_inspections.decision_reason: Experience decisions must support the owner's complete CETA outcome and retained controls, rather than shrink the product to a convenient demonstrable subset.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Mission/outcomes, populations, priorities and dependency-aware tradeoffs
Evidence/uncertainty, inclusion, protected outcomes and full-scope acceptance

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Trace real mission/tasks and inclusion to priorities, tradeoffs, feasibility, dependencies and outcome measures. Record dissent/reopening conditions. Do not import another product's strategy, copy competitor assets, invent a market/customer portfolio or equate engagement with user benefit. Investment and external commitments remain current owner decisions.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Protected human research and honest interpretation
source_inspections.decision_reason: User/assistive acceptance claims require actual method, population, context and evidence; synthetic examples and AI summaries cannot fabricate participants or representative results.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Question/method/population and separation of evidence/interpretation
Consent, privacy/withdrawal, accessible tasks and decision traceability

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Before actual research bind question, recruitment, protocol, participant safeguards, consent/recording, language/accessibility, privacy, retention and decision use. Preserve raw evidence, rival interpretations, dissent and negative cases. No outreach, participant capture, incentive, sensitive-attribute inference or research session occurred here.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Coherent native journeys, patterns and state taxonomy
source_inspections.decision_reason: Conversation, current work, approvals, memory/evidence, models and recovery need one experience structure connected to actual domain state and ownership.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Journeys/states/patterns, information and actual use-case ownership
Permission/access, exceptions, degraded behavior and consumer validation

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Trace journeys, states, information/content, controls, patterns, access and exceptions to the existing product/component contracts. Reuse patterns only where task context fits. Keep UI architecture separate from implemented behavior; no rival design authority or cross-project pattern/brand import is created.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Task-complete native UX and implementation fidelity
source_inspections.decision_reason: The intended product must be usable through complete tasks, including denial/error/recovery, with actual state, source meaning and authority.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Goals/tasks/flows, content and authoritative state feedback
Representative access, privacy, failures and real implementation outcomes

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Specify flows/content/feedback/permissions, access, device constraints and tests tied to original requirements. Validate implemented—not merely prototype—task success, comprehension, latency, privacy and recovery with relevant users. No heuristic or AI critique is represented as lived-experience acceptance.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Native UI surfaces, controls and meaningful status
source_inspections.decision_reason: The required native Windows UI needs actual enabled control use cases, coherent state feedback, accessible focus/input and long-path/content handling.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Surfaces/components/state hierarchy and real action/data binding
Focus/access/scaling, failure, latency and installed UI evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Specify actual surfaces, component/loading/error/offline/uncertain states, scaling, keyboard/screen-reader order and content fit. Keep data/permission enforcement in its real boundary; visual color/status cannot grant trust. Test double clicks, stale approvals, late callbacks, restarts/multiple windows and AI loss on actual UI paths.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Readable CETA visual language and provenance
source_inspections.decision_reason: Native hierarchy, typography, color, icons and evidence/status displays affect comprehension, access and truthful product self-description.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Hierarchy/type/color/imagery and source/rights identity
Accessible alternatives, localization/rendering and factual status fidelity

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep semantic non-color status, contrast, readable scaling/reflow/content fit and accessible alternatives. Track actual asset/source/license/version and local rendering constraints; no other project's branding, assets or cultural representation is imported. A screenshot/style score is not comprehension, access or permission evidence.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Product graphics and evidence displays
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA interface/help/diagram/graph graphics communicate task and evidence meaning and require provenance, access and accurate representation.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Message, asset identity/provenance and accurate visual representation
Access/rights, source-bound content, correction and audience evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Bind actual message/audience/medium/asset/version/rights and accessible alternatives. Verify scaling, nonvisual meaning, content/localization and implementation fidelity. Polish, cropping, illustrative scale or generated assets do not prove truth or audience comprehension. External publication remains separately authorized.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: State-linked motion, timing and static alternatives
source_inspections.decision_reason: Loading/transition/feedback timing in the native UI must preserve control, focus, access and actual state even when decorative animation is absent.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: State/feedback timing, purpose, interruption and resources
Reduced/static alternatives, cancellation/failure and actual device/user tests

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Define intentional triggers, timing, interruption, reduced/no-motion status, focus and resource budgets for motion actually used. Static accessible feedback must preserve the same outcome. No animation requirement or universal comfort threshold is invented; real device/user sensitivity evidence is needed before motion-health/access claims.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Audio cues and voice-output privacy/access
source_inspections.decision_reason: The explicit local voice lane and any real audio status cue affect meaning, privacy, access and user control; critical status cannot rely only on sound.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Cue/source/listener/device, meaning, rights and timed feedback
Consent/privacy, mute/alternate access, failure and environment evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Specify actual cue/speech/source/rights/device, timing/loudness/priority, interruption/mute, text/caption/visual equivalents and degraded behavior. Do not invent audio assets or infer hearing ability/cultural meaning. Studio/loudness data is not comprehension or safe listener/environment evidence; capture/output remains separately scoped.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Explicit local voice capture, repair and independent action authority
source_inspections.decision_reason: SPEC-33 retains local voice with consent, provenance and cancellation. Recognition confidence cannot authenticate a speaker or authorize a consequential effect.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Invocation/capture, recognition/transcript, turn-taking and source identity
Authority/confirmation, uncertainty, privacy, cancellation and representative tests

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Separate capture, recognition, intent, policy, confirmation, execution, response and logging. Keep visible capture status, transcript/correction, ambiguity, cancellation, privacy, spoofing/noise/accent/language tests and keyboard/text alternatives. No speech model, supported language/population, recording permission or voice result is invented.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Faithful conversation, correction and governed tool use
source_inspections.decision_reason: Ordinary conversation is core CETA behavior. Fluency is neither accurate retrieval, understanding, consent, authority nor task completion.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Dialogue/intent/context, truthful recollection and independent expression
Privacy/authority, tool errors, correction/exit and actual semantic evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Preserve exact instructions, scope/format/negations, turn corrections, retrieved sources, uncertainty, refusals and terminal state. Keep dialogue/retrieval/generation/policy/tool authority separate and real stop/exit/nonconversational recovery available. Test prompt injection, context loss, ambiguity, hidden tools, long turns, privacy and failure; avoid fabricated inner identity, emotional pressure and endless repair loops.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Spatial frames and safe human interface in physical lanes
source_inspections.decision_reason: The retained physical/robot variant can rely on workspace, map, orientation, boundaries and calibration. This does not require an immersive desktop UI.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Physical space/frame/anchor identity, calibration and uncertain observations
Exact physical authority, access/safe exit and environmental outcome evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: For actual selected physical spatial behavior bind frame/units/anchor/map/device/time/calibration, tracking uncertainty, operator authority, geofence/collision constraints, accessible non-spatial fallback and independent safe exit/stop. No space, 3D renderer, tracking system, motion comfort or spatial qualification is invented.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: AR overlay design outside the declared product
source_inspections.decision_reason: The supplied native Windows, local conversation/work, voice and selected-screen interpretation requirements contain no AR/headset/physical-world overlay use case. A qualified physical adapter does not itself create an AR display requirement.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Declared product/capability boundary and retained physical obligations

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: No AR overlay, field-of-view/depth/occlusion, headset tracking, or AR physical-task interface is selected or changed. This decision preserves all required physical/device safety and capture clauses. Reopen on an actual AR overlay/tracking/display use case, selected AR device or material AR privacy/access/safety claim.

non_applicability_context.basis: Declared product requirements and actual component/work-package boundary; no source text or required physical capability removed.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Immersive VR world and embodiment outside the declared product
source_inspections.decision_reason: No VR headset, room-scale environment, virtual locomotion/embodiment, virtual world or immersive operating mode is specified for this CETA build.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Declared native modalities, staging boundary and full-scope fidelity

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Native text/voice/screen interpretation and controlled candidate staging do not implement immersive VR. Preserve actual device/physical controls and user exit requirements. Reopen on a selected VR world/headset/locomotion/haptics/supervision use case or any material VR comfort/privacy/accessibility/safety claim.

non_applicability_context.basis: Declared product requirements and actual component/work-package boundary; no source text or required physical capability removed.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Combined immersive XR interface outside the declared product
source_inspections.decision_reason: The current specified modalities do not combine AR/VR/immersive spatial or wearable experiences. Multiple local input lanes are not automatically an XR system.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Explicit product/modalities and material scope-change trigger

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: No cross-immersive rendering, embodiment, coordinate-world transition or XR device has been selected. This does not remove voice/screen/physical lane requirements. Reopen on a real AR/VR/wearable/immersive collaborative modality or XR state/tracking/comfort/privacy/access claim.

non_applicability_context.basis: Declared product requirements and actual component/work-package boundary; no source text or required physical capability removed.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Game mechanics and player economy outside the declared product
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA's governing task cycle is not a game/player/reward/economy system. No game mechanic, live player population, wagering, monetization or game social world is specified.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Declared product, task/conversation and non-game staging boundary

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Retain truthful dialogue, user agency and any generated-content safeguards without inventing a game feature. Reopen if an actual playable/game-like rule/reward/social/economy system is introduced, or a qualified game-specific use case is expressly added. Engagement never substitutes for the required operating outcome.

non_applicability_context.basis: Declared product requirements and actual component/work-package boundary; no source text or required physical capability removed.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Playable level geometry, encounters and progression outside the product
source_inspections.decision_reason: The supplied staging/simulation requirement concerns governed candidates and prediction-versus-outcome evidence, with no player levels, encounters or difficulty system.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Actual proposal/staging semantics and preserved mandatory task/physical controls

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Graph/task navigation and a safe physical workspace do not become a playable level. No game/simulation level layout, pacing/checkpoint difficulty or player progression is introduced. Reopen on actual interactive level/virtual training-space content or a declared game/level-specific scope; preserve all real task and physical safety controls.

non_applicability_context.basis: Declared product requirements and actual component/work-package boundary; no source text or required physical capability removed.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Creative narrative outputs and fiction/fact distinction
source_inspections.decision_reason: Language assistance can produce requested story or dialogue content; CETA does not currently own a game narrative engine, fictional world or character canon.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Attributed/generative content, faithful dialogue and fiction/fact provenance
Rights/privacy, accessible correction and bounded content evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: For actual requested narrative drafts preserve source/author/fiction/generated status, audience/rights/content constraints, continuity, user choice and correction. Never substitute fiction for actual Companion history or fabricate lived experience. No fixed game world, emotional targeting, age regime or sensitive-content publication is selected. Reopen specific world/branching/interactive narrative requirements if added.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Truthful native messages, instructions and source-linked content
source_inspections.decision_reason: Interface/help/error/notification/onboarding and ordinary answer content communicates real product behavior and must support understanding, decision and recovery.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Audience/task, source/terms, product state and accurate message meaning
Disclosure/access/localization, error recovery, correction and evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Bind actual audience/task/state/source/version/owner/locale and accessible correction route. Verify claims, terminology, authority/privacy disclosure, content fit and actual behavior. Draft/rendered/translated/published states remain distinct; do not invent facts, citations, consent, legal approval or implemented controls.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Maintained product content ownership and lifecycle
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA answers, help, artifacts, evidence and operational guidance require consistent ownership, source validity, maintenance and retirement rather than uncontrolled volume.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Content mission/inventory, source ownership, standards and maintained artifacts
Privacy/access, claim freshness, correction/retirement and evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Use established source/authority/artifact ledgers for real content channels and version/rights/freshness/workflow decisions. Keep public distribution and external records rules separately scoped. No rival editorial authority, unowned publication portfolio, staffing or metric-to-benefit claim is invented.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Executable technical instructions bound to actual version/environment
source_inspections.decision_reason: Developer/operator/user/build/install/migration/recovery documentation must refer to actual files, commands, permissions and supported behavior.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Reader/task/version, authoritative source and actual commands
Permissions, truthful errors/recovery, compatibility and reproduced evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Execute representative documented commands where claimed; preserve exact source/artifact/version/environment, prerequisite, result, warning and repair path. Mark illustrative/unrun instructions plainly and maintain accessible correction/version guidance. A rendered page, grammar review or old release label is not executed proof.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Substantiated product/onboarding copy and informed choice
source_inspections.decision_reason: Native onboarding, notices, disclosures and product claims can influence consent and action, even without a marketing campaign or commercial offer.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Claim/audience/state identity, substantiation and clear conditions
Consent/access/privacy, correction and actual comprehension evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Tie actual claims/material conditions to implemented behavior and evidence. Keep readiness/liveness/model quality distinct and choices understandable/accessibly reversible. No testimonial, scarcity, fee, guarantee, targeting rationale, audience culture or conversion-to-benefit claim is invented; external publication remains reserved.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Source-language meaning, locale formatting and declared translation scope
source_inspections.decision_reason: Language, date/number/unit formatting, Unicode content, voice and native rendering can materially change meaning even before a translation pack is selected.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Source/locale/terms, meaning, formats and original data integrity
Human translation authority, access/privacy, fallback and locale evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Declare actual supported locale/source/fallback and terms; preserve meaning, units, critical disclosure, scripts/direction, content fit, voice and access. Do not infer culture or a locale matrix from time zone/OS/user intensity. Qualified cultural/domain review is required for material translated claims. Preserve the misplaced input/role bodies and explicit source-input gap noted below.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Explicit locale boundaries and invariant security/data semantics
source_inspections.decision_reason: The product processes user language, timestamps, units and formatted data; hidden global locale assumptions could alter content or exact security semantics.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Locale variation/resources, canonical data, precision and time boundaries
Regional/sensitive scope, accessible fallback and actual supported-matrix evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep locale-aware presentation separate from canonical signed/counter/time bytes. Declare supported scripts/formats/defaults/fallback and test lossless parsing, direction/plurals/sorting/timezones/data and locale switching as applicable.
